analysis.title: EQ Technical Analysis - Expect rebound in Nvidia
key_insights: UBS S&T (Desmond Chee, 03-Nov-2026, not a product of UBS Research) is bullish short-term on Nvidia: spot 202.06 (close 2 Nov), down from 216.00 on 27 Oct against UBS's expectation. UBS expects the unfilled gap-downs of 30 Oct and 12 Oct to fill, an advance to 229.11, targeting 242.12 then 249.13. A close below 189.66 would turn the view bearish, targeting 171.03 then 164.27.

Meta Platforms outlook is neutral: spot 606.73, down from 630.56 on 27 Oct, against UBS's expectation of a bounce off the Cloud. UBS expects a rebound to 689.68 to fill the 22 Oct gap-down, but not enough to lift Meta above the Cloud. A close above the Cloud at 707.47 would turn it bullish (796.25, then 870.93). A close below 524.49 would turn it bearish (479.80).

Alphabet outlook is bearish: spot 278.99, down from 316.80 on 27 Oct, against UBS's expectation of a near-term rebound. It closed below 314.90, targeting 272.11 then 256.00. It has closed below the lower Bollinger band for three sessions, which suggests a rebound to 338.36 that is unlikely to break above the Cloud. A close above 384.48 is needed for a bullish outlook.

Oracle outlook is bearish: spot 119.22, down from 126.06 on 27 Oct, in line with UBS's expectation. It failed to hold within the Cloud for the fourth time since end-September. UBS expects a rebound to 136.59 to fill the 30 Oct and 2 Nov gap-downs, rejected within the Cloud region (142.62-145.20), with targets of 114.50 then 99.87. A close above the Cloud would turn it bullish (170.70, then 197.79).

Alibaba outlook is bearish: spot 99.20, up from 97.60 on 27 Oct, in line with UBS's expectation of a rebound. UBS expects an advance to 108.30 to fill the 20 and 22 Oct gap-downs but treats rebounds as corrective given multiple upside failures since mid-September. Targets are 88.65 then 77.35. A close above the Cloud (114.08) would turn it bullish (130.30, then 154.20).
Across the five names, UBS's 27 Oct calls were wrong on Nvidia, Meta and Alphabet (all fell) and right on Oracle and Alibaba.
